reviews.text:
We started our PetBar journey with the University Park location, but moved to the new Lakewood location as soon as they opened. The team in Lakewood is warm and welcoming to pups and puppy parents alike! I would also note that their staff has remained consistent since opening, which is unusual in the pet grooming business.

The team in Lakewood was kind and supportive as our original 2 pups moved through advanced age and various illnesses. They asked about them as they individually grew too sick to be groomed and hugged me when I shared their inevitable passing.

PetBar Lakewood now greets our little dachshund Ginger with the same warm smiles. We are delighted to have this caring  service in our little corner of Dallas.

My experience with Pet Bar Lakewood was unfortunately very poor. The front desk customer service is not up to par to other grooming services that I previously experienced.  But even that would have made my experiences there passable if not for the groomer that was tasked with grooming my dog. Aaron was unfortunately a disappointment. He never seemed that interested in putting his best foot forward in grooming my dog. Every time I brought my dog in he did not give me confidence he could do a great job. And the results backed up my concerns. My dog was groomed by him a couple times and it was never cut as well as it could have been. The last time I went, Aaron cut my dog very unevenly. Also I dont think all the grooming services I paid for (teeth cleaning, bath etc) were actually done on the last visit. And if they were they weren't done well because after a couple days my dog didn't smell fresh anymore. BUT the kicker in my last visit was that after I picked my dog up and got it home, I noticed it was walking with a limp. I checked my dog's paw and it seems that it must have sustained an injury from how it's nails were cut on it's back right paw. That took the cake. Worst grooming experience ever.
I’m so glad I found this place. It is professionally run. It was easy to get an appointment. The groomer did a great job on my mini golden doodle. The price was fair.

Great option for self service in between grooms or extra stinky doggie on the go.  Recommend making a reservation which is easy online. It was busy on a Saturday morning, but no waiting…just be cautious of your dog doesn’t do well with other dogs in their area.

Abigail did a fantastic job with our 5-month-old puppy's first grooming. She was intentional about explaining the process and how he might respond, and then gave me helpful feedback at pickup about how he did. He looks great and had a positive first grooming experience! Highly recommend!

I visited the pet bar this last Sunday for the first time. My golden doodle has never been so clean. People were friendly and boutique was clean. I’m going to be a return customer. I highly recommend it.
This place is fab! My dog looked incredible and was so happy afterwards with her cutie bows.

Victoria at PetBar Lakewood is the absolute best. I have two huge Bernese mountain dogs and she takes her name making sure they are completely brushed out and look amazing when they are done! And they even like her on top of it!
Our pups Teddy and Lilly love this place. They do a great job on bathing and grooming, are quick, and always have appointments available.

I absolutely love the Pet Bar! I have been bringing my dog Maho here almost every week for the past 3 years! Will, Victoria and Bri always greet us with a smile and lots of love for Maho! They all do a wonderful job! Highly recommend this location and I am so glad to have The Pet Bar in our neighborhood!! 10 stars

I came here because one of my neighbors recommended it. Worst mistake ever. I went over how I wanted the haircut & they left my baby bald. He wasn’t matted so there was no reason for that. HES A GOLDEN DOODLE I ASKED FOR A TRIM AND A TEDDY BEAR CUT. If I could leave a negative star review or 0 I would.

Edit: I went back to see if they could fix his un even cut. The nice front desk lady went to grab the manager & she rolled her eyes & was clearly talking smack. She dodged me & didn’t even give me the time of day. Why is she in a manager position? The groomer came out to apologize, she was more mature & more caring than the actual manager. Mind you this is the person in charge of this place where you trust with your loved fur babies. She even mentioned checking the cameras to check if I had asked for the teddy bear haircut? Why would I lie about that when clearly the groomer is agreeing that she was wrong. Said they approved a summer cut? WHAT THE HELL IS A SUMMER CUT? & WHO APPROVED IT?! NOT ME! Absolutely horrible experience.

Will did an exceptional job grooming my Australian shepherd today. He listened to my concerns, gave professional advice and took care of my dog as if it was his own.

I highly recommend Will and this Petbar location for any grooming needs!
Customer service is horrible i can’t believe how cocky and rude they are and theyre grooming service is horrible so overpriced might as well go to petco or some
It was the first time I took my pet there...they treated her wonderfully and made her look beautiful!!! And I was also happy with the price I paid for her....
Will really listened to what I wanted and my doggie looks great.
Our groomer, Adriana, always does a wonderful job. I am so grateful to have found PetBar for my two pups.

Andrea is the Best!!!!  She really made my babies look great!  Me and my daughter have schnauzers and their cuts were perfect. The staff is so friendly and the Boutique is so  clean. I highly recommend 🤎🤎🐾
Waste of my time. Called for an appt for grooming get there just so they tell me they have no availability??! I had so many other things to do and just wasted my time

Stopped by on a Sunday not knowing they were closed! The Owner was there doing his Sunday checklist and let me come in in and wash both of my dogs… when they were closed! Best customer service ever!! If you need a spot to either wash your own dog or have your dog professionally groomed… this is your spot!
The very best!
Beautiful, clean and everything updated. Pleasantly surprised
We have gone here now 3 different times and had a different groomer each time, and haven’t been dissatisfied once! We love this place and it’s very reasonably priced.
Took my Aussie (60lb) today for a quick wash. Tubs were a good size, easy to access, water pressure and temp were great as were all the shampoo, brushes, towels. Will be back!
They do such a great job every time! Especially thankful for Abigail and her detailed and efficient work!

We absolutely love bringing our Great Pyrenees to Abigail at Petbar in Lakewood! As owners of a breed that requires very specific grooming to avoid skin issues and even sunburn, it gives us such peace of mind knowing she is in the best hands. Abigail is incredibly knowledgeable about all dog breeds and always takes the time to make sure our sweet girl gets exactly the type of care she needs.

Every single grooming appointment with Abigail has been exceptional - our dog has never looked better, and she genuinely seems happier and more comfortable after each visit. It’s rare to find a groomer who is both technically skilled and truly caring, but Abigail is exactly that. We are repeat customers because she consistently goes above and beyond.

If you’re looking for a groomer you can trust completely, especially for breeds with special grooming needs, I can’t recommend Abigail enough!
Abigail does the best job on our mini poodle! She gave him a Christmas gift today with his picture in an ornament, treats, and a toy! So incredibly thoughtful!!

ABIGAIL is the best!!! She always grooms my pup perfectly and goes above and beyond. She gave him a little Christmas basket this morning with ornaments of him. I’ll forever cherish them. Thank you Abigail!

I want to start by saying the self-service bathing stations are very convenient, clean, and well maintained. I really appreciate that they offer this option, and it’s something I’ve enjoyed using in the past.

Unfortunately, my most recent experience was extremely disappointing. The woman at the front desk with orange hair was very unprofessional and rude in the way she handled my concerns. Her communication came across as dismissive and belittling rather than helpful or customer-focused.

I ultimately decided not to leave my dog for grooming because it was clear they did not have the experience or expertise to groom him properly. Instead of discussing breed-appropriate grooming or working with shears, the only solution offered was to shave him down entirely. For a grooming service that costs $150+, I would expect a higher level of skill, training, and care—especially when it comes to proper grooming techniques beyond simply using razors. What am I paying for then?

Overall, it seems there is a clear lack of professional training and customer service standards. I also believe the front desk position should be filled by someone who knows how to professionally handle client requests and concerns. A more knowledgeable and respectful approach would make a significant difference.

I had such a great experience here!!!  I used the self-service wash for my senior dog, who was long overdue and really needed a nail trim. He can be very difficult with his nails, but Lauren was absolutely AMAZING. She stepped in to help with so much patience and care.

She even grabbed something to gently cover his ears while I used the blow dryer, which was the sweetest touch. It made the whole experience so much easier on him and on me.

We will definitely be back! 💛🐾

Michael has done an amazing job with my baby, Agnes! He actively listens and is always receptive and attentive to how I want my girl to look. He asks questions, and makes sure the owner's wants are taken into consideration, while making sure the pup is well taken care of. So thankful I found Petbar! It's always a positive experience!

Abigail is amazing! I’m very particular about our Bernedoodle’s haircut, and she knocks it out of the park every single visit. She listens, pays attention to every detail, and our pup always comes home looking perfect. So thankful we found her!

Abigale at the Lakewood location did a fantastic job grooming Rosie today. Rosie is a 4 year ole BorDoodle
(Border collie poodle) and she has long hair like a sheep dog. Usually she looks rough after her grooming but today she looked great. I will continue to use Petbar and Abigale.
Scout had a really great grooming experience.  He just looked adorable.  Very nice groomers
Abigail does a great job with both our dogs. She is very gentle with our older dog and manages to control our wiggly doodle! Cuts are perfect every time!

William has been grooming my doodle, Hampton, for about a year now and has been by far the best I’ve worked with. His attention to detail and overall care is 10/10. I highly recommend William to those seeking a groomer in DFW.
Abigail is amazing did a wonderful job on both of my guys. We are so excited to have found her.

This place is amazing! My husband and I were going out of town and needed our toy poodle to get a haircut before we left & the petbar fit him into their schedule that same day and did amazing with him! When you walk in all the staff is friendly the place is really clean & they even have cameras in the lobby to see where your dog is. William cut our biscuit boys hair and we have 0 complaints! He did a phenomenal job & we couldn’t be more grateful. We will definitely be back!

We’ve had a great experience having our wheaten terrier groomed with William. We’ve now used him on 3 separate occasions. He always listen to my specific requests and does a great job with our pup, who can be a little anxious and stubborn. Highly recommend.

Tried the self wash station today for the first time. It was about $5 more expensive than other places, and it wasn’t worth it. Should be $5 cheaper. The wash station was alright, shampoos didn’t have any scent. The blow dry station was awful though. There was other dog fur flying around from neighboring dogs being dried. Pretty sure we both left dirtier than we came. Not worth it.

abigail is amazing. she listens to each little request i have for my labradoodle’s grooming and manages to exceed my expectations. this is the most positive experience i’ve had so far with a groomer anywhere. my favorite part is getting pics from petbar of my baby’s cut! such a great customer service strategy for nervous dog moms!

Abigail at PetBar is amazing! My anxious pup, Lilly, is always so well cared for. Abigail takes the time to ask how I’d like her styled, keeps her calm, and gets her looking adorable every time. Lilly always leaves fluffed, happy, and bandana-ready!
I have been taking my little doodles here for about a year now. Love Abigail!! She does the best job and is kind to the pups!!
Love PetBar Lakewood! The staff is amazing and my dog Lucy gets so excited when we pull up! She goes for frequent baths and Abigail is the best goldendoodle groomer ever!
It was my first time taking my mini schnauzer puppy. I absolutely loved Abigail she did an amazing job! I would definitely recommend her to anyone. Thank you petbar.
Abigail is terrific!
Abigail is the best! She does an excellent job and my dog Gracie loves her!
Abigail at PetBar Lakewood is our favorite! I have a cockapoo and a golden doodle. She is wonderful and keeps my babies safe and at ease. We are very happy here!

Dolly gets a bath every week at pet bar and sees Abigail for grooming every six weeks. She is always so happy to go inside and loves everyone who is part of the team. We truly appreciate how good the experience is for our pup!
Abigail is great!!! She was extremely patient with my anxious dog and even came in early to groom him so he would feel more comfortable

We absolutely love Abigail! She does an amazing job grooming our sheepadoodle — every time, her coat is perfectly trimmed to the right length, she is super clean, and she always manages to give her the cutest teddy bear face. It's clear she really knows what she's doing and takes pride in her work. What makes it even better is how excited and happy our dog is to see her when she arrives — that says it all. We trust her completely and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a skilled and caring groomer.
I took my miniature schnauzer Zoro to PetBar about a year back and I was kindly introduced to Abigail. Ever since then I have been returning because every time we go she does a fantastic job!
Abigail did a great job on our dog Korra!
My groomer is wonderful, Abby always does everything I ask her to do. Asa loves her and she always has him out quickly. The place is very clean and inviting
Everyone is so professional and polite. They really take care of their customers
Took my golden doodle here and they did a great job! He looked super clean, smelled great, and seemed really happy after. Aaron was friendly and quick.  Will definitely be back!

Everyone that answers the phone or who is at the front desk is always super kind with great customer service!!
And our groomer - Abigail - is very personable and professional!! Abigail does a great job grooming Luna - every time!!
Best Giant schnauzer cut in over 1 year from other groomers. We would highly recommend this location and groomer.
Aaron does a great job with our Maltese!!
The Lakewood Petbar is great!! Will does the absolute best job with my cavapoo’s haircut.
Will did a great job on my pup ! He is ready for summer .
Our groomer was short with us and rude and we werent able to watch our dog while he was groomed. Our dog kept shaking nervously for a week after his appointment.
Great service! Our groomer Abigail did an incredible job with my fur baby!
It was my dog’s first time at the Petbar. He did awesome. Thanks to William. Highly recommend him for your fur babies!

I did not like the service provided. I spoke with the groomer about how I wanted my dogs haircut. After picking him up I realized he only received a bath because he did not get a haircut not to mention that I was charged 100.00 dollars for this service. I was short changed, I paid 100.00 for a bath. With that said I will not return to this establishment.

We had a great experience with William at Pet Bar. He was very kind and gentle with our nervous pup and kept her with him the whole time she was there. He is also meticulous about his grooming, which we really appreciate. We have a doodle and can be particular about her hair, so I really appreciated that he went through his plans prior to her haircut. Highly recommend William for your grooming needs!
We love Pet Bar! Aaron always takes good care of my Maltipoo, Holly and gets her groomed very efficiently. He does a great job of giving her the “puppy cut,” I highly recommend him!

I came here to get my dog Twinkie groomed with Abigail on Friday. Everything from calling to booking an appointment, arriving, and especially the hospitable service was impeccable.
I have heard amazing things from this groomer and the rumors were correct.
I know my baby looks a little rough in the first picture but she made him look so beautiful and WHITE!
She made me feel so comfortable leaving him here and she explained everything to me how it could take anywhere from 3-4 hours. Which I was fine with but she got him out in an hour in a half. She even sent me a picture of him, (💙10 out of 10) will definitely be a returning customer.

Be careful going here , the manager takes things personal  and your money . You pay before you can see what has been done scam.Read till the end, do they look the same hairstyle ?I have been taking my dog here for about a year now and I'm paying 82 dollars for his plan each time, and now I asked the manager  for an apology so no hard feeling but nothing  but disappointed and the manager just wanted your money 🤑💰 k and I love my dog . She made it seem like my fault for being him to them. Now read her response. Better management needed.
They always do a great job with our pup
So so pleased!!!  Maggie looks precious - Abigail is so good!  And!  The entire appointment was under 2 hours !  Definitely 💯 …
Abigail always does an incredible job on our Bernedoodle, Moose! The staff is great and Moose is always done in a timely manner!

I recently took my dog to Pet Bar off Lakewood in Dallas for a grooming appointment. Over the phone, I was quoted $65 for a bath and groom. When I arrived at the facility, I reconfirmed the price. However, when I picked up my dog several hours later—due to the groomer being behind schedule—I was charged $81 instead.

I called today to ask about the price discrepancy, and I was told that the cost depends on the groomer. This lack of transparency is frustrating, as I was given a clear quote beforehand. If pricing varies, customers should be informed upfront to avoid unexpected charges.

While I appreciate the service provided, I believe Pet Bar should be more consistent with their pricing and communication.
I love coming here. The staff is always so nice and friendly!!
My first experience with PetBar and it was very positive. Friendly and professional staff. Thorough. And the groomer did a great job!

Love this location! My golden doodle Riley was groomed today and the staff was so kind and helpful! She looks so cute! Highly recommend. William does an AMAZING job with the cuts. Even when my dog is matted up he works his magic and the cuts are always so cute!!
I am really pleased with Gus’ grooming. The staff was friendly and efficient.
Clean wash bays and very friendly staff!  Highly recommend.

Used the self-service to bathe and blow dry my pup, and they have everything you need including various shampoos, conditioners, brushes, towels, ear cleaners, etc. I brought all my own items, but you don’t have to unless you want to. I really appreciated the drying stations. Having the tables made it so easy to blow my dog dry. This location is incredibly clean, and the staff is so nice. It made bath day for my pup so much easier. No more bending over the bath tub. I look forward to returning!
Great customer service, I took my Dog and tried the self serve and it was a smooth process with there help and would highly recommend for y’all to stop by to get your Dog taken care of‼️

Petbar is amazing! My dog decided to roll around in duck feces on our walk at White Rock Lake, so I had to take him for a bath immediately after, and he was in desperate need of a nail trim as well. I thought I needed an appointment, but that was not the case! I was able to do a walk-in nail trim and they were super skilled with my pup, who has awful separation anxiety and squirms terribly while getting his nails trimmed. I highly recommend this Petbar location and will definitely be back!
Great experience! First time getting the pups groomed here and Abigail was amazing! Two very happy good boyes!

This was my first experience at petbar and both of my Australian Shepherds came back exactly as I wanted. Abigail did a great job and listened to what I wanted beforehand. She even got their picture together by the Christmas tree! We will definitely be back!

It was my first time in …
The staff showed me everything and guided me on all that was available which was everything to give my dog a great bath and experience….. I will definitely use them for my pet going forward!!!!💥💥💥💥 …
Love Pet Bar! This location is so fast and my 2 shitzus always come back relaxed and ready for a nap! No stress at all! They always listen to what we want and deliver very cute babies!

Incredibly unhelpful and unprofessional. Would recommend you don’t trust your dog here and find somewhere else. They could not tell me how short they were going to cut it before he went in, and seemed like they were just going to shave him but didn’t want to tell me. All the dogs were trembling and terrier in there and it was so loud I couldn’t even speak to anyone without yelling over the noise. Unfortunate because we’ve used other petbar locations and had a great experience. Will be using somewhere else in the future.

I brought my golden doodle in for the self-serve bath (fantastic products, equipment, towels). I noticed my dogs nails were a little longer than they should be and the groomers were able to get me in immediately after the bath for a canine Mani/Pedi. Thank you for going above and beyond!
They have done a great job of grooming my older dog and their products are great in the self wash

This was an amazing experience for both my service dog and myself. I utilize a wheelchair and everything was accessible. They had everything you would need. I did bring my own S/C and brushes/scrubbers. We will definitely be back!
Always welcoming and efficient.  My little dog does not mind going there at all

Tried here three times, but this will be our last.  The groomers and staff have always been nice and I do think they do a good job, but each time I have provided pictures and specific instructions on what I wanted done to my pup, but there seems to be a lack of details each time.  They have a management system where there should be notes from each visit on what was done before, but I have to explain and show pics each time to a different person so there is no consistency.  And with the amount of noise inside, I have to ask the groomer to step outside just so we can talk.  The noise inside is so loud, you have to be within less than a foot from the person just to talk.  It's one of the main reasons I will not be back as it's so distracting to customers, I can't imagine what it's like for the groomers and the staff.  And the dogs.  I feel bad for the animals in that environment.  Good people, but the owner/franchisee needs to make some improvements.

PetBar is in a very convenient location for me and they have lots of availability. It’s a bit pricey and extremely loud in there when you’re trying to talk with the dog stylist about what you’re looking for. We’ve been there twice and my dog’s cut was pretty close to what we were looking for yet not as good as we’re used to.

Up charged without telling me
Expect me to tip before even seeing my dog
Will Not be coming back

I just picked up my golden doodle and I just want to say Jose did an amazing job. She’s was mated and we had previous had terrible experiences shaving her but Jose made sure she’s safe and she still looks amazing. Thank you so much Jose!!! Biscuit loves you!!!
Excellent service and speed. Teddy was done in a hour.
Summitt loves visiting petbar for her baths! The staff are wonderful!
Great experience all around.
Always happy with Arron's work.
